findings.current: It was far more cunning than most humans or monsters.
findings.defect: “Most” weakens the source’s comparison: the Doppelganger was vastly more cunning than ordinary humans or monsters, not merely more cunning than most of them.
findings.rationale: 월등하게 교활했다 and 여느 인간이나 몬스터와 비교해도 establish a strong comparison against ordinary humans or monsters.
findings.replacement: It was far more cunning than any ordinary human or monster.

findings.current: He must have pushed himself beyond his limits, too.
findings.defect: This shifts the inference from using power beyond his limits to pushing himself beyond them, which can describe exertion without specifying the power use stated in the source.
findings.rationale: 놈도 한계 이상의 힘을 사용한 것이 분명해 specifically says he must have used power exceeding his limits.
findings.replacement: He must have used power beyond his limits, too.

summary: Two minor fidelity losses: the comparison of the Doppelganger’s cunning is weakened, and its inference about Taekyung’s power use becomes less specific.
